    A

    App - Class in com.cooke.shapes
    Main loop Class CLI shape builder application; user will be presented with a menu of shapes to choose from, then user will be prompted to specify the size parameters of the shape; these parameters will change for each shape; the user will then be shown the calculated area of the shape if it is a 2D shape, or the volume of the shape if it is 3D.

    readPositiveDouble(Scanner, String) - Static method in class com.cooke.shapes.App
    Static Method that reads a positive double from a scanner The user will be prompted with the String argument; the method will loop until the user supplies a number that is greater than 0.
    readPositiveInt(Scanner, String) - Static method in class com.cooke.shapes.App
    Static Method that reads a positive integer from a scanner The user will be prompted with the String argument; the method will loop until the user supplies a number that is greater than 0.
    readYorN(Scanner, String) - Static method in class com.cooke.shapes.App
    Static Method that reads a 'y' or 'n' character from a scanner The user will be prompted with the String argument; the method will loop until the user supplies a 'y' or 'n' character; not case sensitive.
